name: Spark of Divinity (Heritage)
body:
Your ancestral connection to divine energies permits you to cast certain spells.

Prerequisite(s): Chaotic, evil, good, or lawful subtype and/or outsider type.

Benefit(s): Choose bless, command, or shield of faith. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 4th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.
